name: stepper
title: Stepper
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: Multi-step navigation, horizontal or vertical, built on react-aria `Tabs`: arrow keys, Home and End move between steps and Enter or Space selects one (manual activation). `value`/`defaultValue`/`onValueChange` hold the current step. Each `StepperItem` is a tab whose `data-state` is `completed` (before the current step, or `isCompleted`), `active` or `inactive`; `isDisabled` skips it and `isLoading` shows the loading indicator. `indicators` swaps an indicator's content per state. `StepperContent` panels show the current step's content.

meta.origin: reui.io (https://reui.io/docs/components/base/stepper, MIT), via EMITTE; rebuilt on react-aria Tabs
